Class SemanticMatchInspector

java.lang.Object
com.shaft.gui.internal.locator.semantic.SemanticMatchInspector
public final class SemanticMatchInspector extends Object
Live DOM / aria-snapshot match-count inspection that feeds SemanticLocatorResolver (issue #5817 / parent #5457).

Backend-neutral where possible: aria forests need no browser; Selenium and Playwright paths count uniqueness with the same portable ShaftLocator strategies. Does not heal silently.

  • Method Details

    • fromAriaForest

      public static SemanticElementEvidence fromAriaForest(List<AriaNode> forest, String targetRole, String targetAccessibleName)
      Builds evidence for a target identified by role + accessible name inside an aria snapshot forest, with per-strategy uniqueness counts across the forest.
      Parameters:
      forest - aria-accessible-name tree (from AriaSnapshotHelper)
      targetRole - ARIA role of the intended node
      targetAccessibleName - accessible name of the intended node
      Returns:
      evidence ready for SemanticLocatorResolver.resolve(SemanticElementEvidence)
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when the forest has no matching node

    • inaccessibleWithStructuralFallback

      public static SemanticElementEvidence inaccessibleWithStructuralFallback(List<AriaNode> forest, String css, int cssMatchCount, String xpath, int xpathMatchCount, String notes)
      Localized / inaccessible forest path (FR-4 / SC-3): when the target has no usable semantic name, only structural hints are retained and confidence is capped by the resolver's fallback rules.
      Parameters:
      forest - aria forest (used only for notes / emptiness check)
      css - structural CSS for the target (may be blank)
      cssMatchCount - uniqueness count for css
      xpath - structural XPath for the target (may be blank)
      xpathMatchCount - uniqueness count for xpath
      notes - inspection provenance
      Returns:
      evidence with no semantic signals

    • fromSelenium

      public static SemanticElementEvidence fromSelenium(org.openqa.selenium.SearchContext driver, org.openqa.selenium.By seedLocator)
      Inspects the live Selenium DOM around a unique seed locator and returns evidence with counted strategy uniqueness.
      Parameters:
      driver - active driver / search context
      seedLocator - locator that identifies the intended element
      Returns:
      evidence with live match counts
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when the seed is missing or not unique

      Inspects the live Playwright page around a seed locator and returns evidence with counted strategy uniqueness (getByRole / getByLabel where applicable).
      Parameters:
      page - current Playwright page
      seed - portable seed that uniquely identifies the target
      Returns:
      evidence with live match counts
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when the seed is missing or not unique
